User Agreement

User Agreement

Effective: October 27, 2026 · Last updated: October 27, 2026

Welcome to Attention Museum. This agreement governs your use of the iOS app (the “App”) with its developer (“we”). Please pay particular attention to clauses in bold. Downloading, installing or using the App means you have read and accepted this agreement and the Privacy Policy.

1. Services

  1. The App is a focus timer built around viewing art. Choose a gallery and duration and keep the App in the foreground. On completion, the artwork is added to your device’s collection wall.
  2. No account is required. Focus history, collections and settings are stored only on your device; see the Privacy Policy.
  3. Locking or leaving pauses the timer; time away does not count. Returning within 30 seconds resumes it; a longer absence interrupts the session. Each work is collected only on first completion. Refer to the in-app Focus Rules for the current rules.
  4. We may adjust, add or discontinue features, galleries or works as the product evolves, with reasonable advance notice.

2. Free Features and Pro

  1. Free access includes Landscapes, Portraits, Still Life and the Opening Exhibition, with 15, 25 and 45-minute sessions.
  2. Pro adds East Asian Ink, Impressionism, more durations and poster export. It is available monthly, annually or as a lifetime purchase. The price shown on the App Store purchase page applies.
  3. Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase confirmation. Unless auto-renewal is disabled at least 24 hours before the current period ends, renewal is charged within the final 24 hours at the then-current price.
  4. Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions, or through the App’s settings. Deleting the App does not cancel subscriptions. Pro remains available until the paid period ends after cancellation.
  5. Lifetime is a one-time purchase, valid while the App continues to be offered, with no automatic renewal.
  6. Apple processes all purchases and refunds under its policies. Request refunds from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue refunds directly.
  7. After reinstalling or changing devices, use Restore Purchases to recover active Pro access. Restoring cannot recover deleted collections or focus history.
  8. After Pro expires, collections and Pro gallery previews remain viewable. New Pro sessions, additional durations and poster export require active access; additional durations revert to 25 minutes.

3. Artworks and Intellectual Property

  1. Artwork images are public-domain works from The Met’s Open Access program. Chinese titles, viewing prompts and descriptions are written by us. Original titles, sources and credits are retained in artwork details.
  2. The software, interface, frame and wall assets, text and icons belong to us or their rights holders. We grant a personal, non-transferable, non-exclusive license to use the App on Apple devices you own or control, under App Store usage rules.
  3. Without permission, do not reverse engineer, decompile or disassemble the App except where law expressly permits; copy, sell, rent or commercially exploit the App or its non-public-domain content; or bypass payment mechanisms to obtain Pro.

4. Your Obligations

Use the App lawfully. Do not use it for unlawful activities or disrupt the App or related servers, including museum image servers, for example with automated bulk image requests.

5. Disclaimers

  1. The App helps you set aside focused time. It offers no medical, psychological or learning advice or guarantees. Consult a professional about attention, sleep or health concerns.
  2. Image downloads depend on third-party servers and your connection and may fail temporarily due to service changes or network faults. Sessions do not start until images are ready.
  3. Data stays only on your device. We cannot recover losses caused by deleting the App, resetting progress, replacing or losing a device, system faults or similar events.
  4. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect loss from using or being unable to use the App. Total liability is limited to what you paid for the App in the previous twelve months, subject to mandatory law.

6. Changes and Termination

  1. We may revise this agreement, post the new version here and update its effective date. Material changes will be highlighted in the App or website. Continued use after they take effect constitutes acceptance.
  2. You may stop using and delete the App at any time. We may terminate relevant services if you materially breach this agreement.

7. Governing Law and Disputes

Formation, performance and interpretation are governed by PRC law, excluding Hong Kong SAR, Macao SAR and Taiwan for this agreement. Parties shall first seek an amicable resolution. If unsuccessful, either may bring proceedings before a competent people’s court at our location.

8. Other Provisions

This agreement and the Privacy Policy form the entire agreement. An invalid provision does not affect the others. An English version is available as Terms of Use. For users in mainland China, the Chinese version prevails in case of inconsistency.
